findings.issue: Nodes are heavily overlapping, text labels are clipped, and connection lines are tangled, making the current state completely illegible.
findings.fix: Apply the clean, spaced-out radial layout from the reference design to ensure all node labels and connections are fully readable.

findings.issue: The version transition is displayed as 'v1 -> v1' for both agent actions, which fails to show actual progress or honest state change.
findings.fix: Update the version progression to reflect actual state changes (e.g., 'v41 -> v42' and 'v42 -> v43') as shown in the reference.

findings.issue: The candidate uses a monospace font for the entity graph node labels, which increases their horizontal footprint, causes severe overlapping, and looks less integrated than the sans-serif used in the reference.
findings.fix: Change the font family of the entity graph node labels to the standard sans-serif font used in the reference.

findings.issue: Labels are overlapping heavily (e.g., 'Company research row rc_cardionova' overlapping 'fetch cardionova.com'), destroying the visual hierarchy and readability of the central work surface.
findings.fix: Implement proper node spacing or label truncation to prevent text overlaps and maintain a clean, readable hierarchy.

findings.issue: The nodes in the entity graph are extremely crowded, overlapping, and clashing, violating the calm-but-alive density and the spacing rhythm.
findings.fix: Reposition the nodes with a minimum of 24px clearance between boundaries, adopting the clean radial layout of the reference to prevent text collisions.

findings.issue: Tabs are crowded and suffer from text truncation ('Risk / opportunity ...') due to lack of stable control dimensions.
findings.fix: Introduce the '+3' overflow dropdown pattern to keep tab widths stable and maintain consistent 16px spacing between visible tabs.

findings.issue: The 'Room' button in the chat header is filled with terracotta, violating the single-accent discipline and departing from the reference.
findings.fix: Set the 'Room' toggle button background to neutral dark gray as shown in the reference.

findings.issue: Homen's message box features an unapproved vertical terracotta accent line on its left edge.
findings.fix: Remove the terracotta left border to restore the neutral message container styling.

findings.issue: The send button icon is rendered in neutral gray instead of the approved terracotta accent.
findings.fix: Recolor the send button icon to terracotta to match the reference design.
